title: Tighten remaining JSON field-type and attachment validation
description:
Council multi-round audit residual under existing parser owner TSK-0136. Confirmed issues in JsonDnaSerializer.cs: schemaVersion/noiseSeed use direct double-to-int casts instead of explicit integral/range validation; generic enum parsing accepts numerically represented enum names such as "999" unless Enum.IsDefined is checked; meshGeometry.attachment is silently ignored when present with a non-object, non-null value. These should become deterministic DnaDeserializationException failures without changing valid canonical DNA.

Scope: add strict integer helper(s), require defined enum values, reject malformed present attachment values, and add focused parser/serializer regressions. Keep all behavior parser-level; do not move semantic validation into DefinitionValidator.

Parent owner: TSK-0136. Do not create another parser task.

Validation gate: runtime build plus focused MiniJsonReader/JsonDnaSerializer tests and committed-DNA load sweep. Unity execution is required before closure.
